string: CSS Studio uses the camera only when you record a personal moment to add to your music video.
CSS Studio uses the microphone only when you choose to add narration or sing into your music video.
CSS Studio reads your photo library only to import images into your music video.
CSS Studio saves the music videos you generate to your photo library.
CSS Studio accesses Apple Music to let you score your music video with songs you own.
CSS Studio uses your location only to suggest local festivals and historical anniversaries near you.
